Title: General Availability: New Azure Monitor alerts experience available in Azure Government

Body.Content:
New Azure Monitor alerts experience is now available in Azure Government. The new alerts experience in Azure Monitor brings together the configuration and consumption of all the different alerts in a single place. As part of this update, multi-dimensional metric alerts are also available in Azure Government.

You can learn more about the unified experience here.

See the list of supported resource types for metric alerts in Azure Government.
